title: 2026-12-05 Partner Co-sell Pipeline Review - Solstice Partners
summary: Quarterly co-sell pipeline review with Solstice Partners. Reviewed three active co-sell opportunities, alignment on technical fit and next steps for joint demos and pilots. Discussed pricing guardrails, potential blockers around VPC/private deployment for a regulated customer, and competitor activity (Anthropic, ModelServeX). Agreed on next steps: joint demo scheduling, share Redwood co-sell playbook, pricing spreadsheet, and assign owners for pilot enablement.
topics: Deal 1: FinReg (pilot for financial compliance chatbot)
Deal 2: HealthStream (on-prem private deployment for PHI)
Technical constraints: VPC, KMS, latency SLOs
Commercial: pricing bands, referral margins, pilot scope
transcript:
[00:00:00] Jenna Morales: Hey everyone, thanks for jumping on. Quick roll call?
[00:00:06] Laura Chen: Laura here, Solstice Partner Manager.
[00:00:08] Marcus Reed: Marcus, Alliances.
[00:00:10] Tom Alvarez: Tom, Sales.
[00:00:12] Ravi Kapoor: Ravi, Redwood SE.
[00:00:15] Jenna Morales: Cool. Agenda — pipeline review, tech blockers, next steps. We have about 40 minutes.
[00:00:30] Laura Chen: Sounds good. We're primarily focused on three deals this quarter. Shortest one is FinReg, then HealthStream, then RetailQ.
[00:00:45] Jenna Morales: Great, let's start with FinReg. Tom, can you give the commercial status?
[00:00:52] Tom Alvarez: Yeah, FinReg is in late evaluation. They want a compliance-aware chatbot for customer support, lots of PII, strict retention needs. Solstice has introduced us and we're lined up for a pilot. Pricing expectation from the customer is tight, they'd prefer hosted API to avoid infra overhead.
[00:01:10] Marcus Reed: They also care about audit logs and SOC2.
[00:01:15] Ravi Kapoor: From technical side, hosted Redwood API would work; we can enable token-level logs and longer retention on request but need to check SOC2 + evidence for audit. If they want VPC/private, that'll add time. Latency should be okay for chat use (target < 400ms p95).
[00:01:35] Laura Chen: FinReg mentioned Anthropic as a fallback. They're evaluating across providers.
[00:01:40] Jenna Morales: Noted. Action: Jenna to share pricing bands and a one-pager on SOC2 + audit artifacts. Ravi will run a short benchmark to validate p95 numbers with typical prompt set.
[00:01:55] Tom Alvarez: Timelines: pilot kickoff mid-Jan if we can get the contract by end of December.
[00:02:03] Jenna Morales: Okay. Next, HealthStream — Marcus?
[00:02:10] Marcus Reed: HealthStream is large health system, PHI involved. They insist on private deployment in VPC in their cloud and HSM/KMS integration. It's complicated but high ACV. Solstice already aligned on SOW with them.
[00:02:26] Ravi Kapoor: Technical deep dive: Redwood Private supports VPC and on-prem. But for their specific compliance, we need to map network requirements, KMS integration, and egress controls. We'll need a full compliance pack and possibly a one-week lab deployment to validate.
[00:02:42] Laura Chen: Do we have references for similar HIPA-ish deployments?
[00:02:46] Jenna Morales: We have one existing customer with a similar private deployment, I'll share anonymized notes and the architecture diagram.
[00:02:55] Tom Alvarez: Competition here is ModelServeX — they push an appliance model for on-prem.
[00:03:01] Ravi Kapoor: We should highlight our rollout capabilities and rollback policies; that tends to calm infra teams. Also call out our KV cache and batching to reduce cost per token for heavy workloads.
[00:03:14] Marcus Reed: Timeline wise they want a pilot in Q1.
[00:03:18] Jenna Morales: Action: Ravi to draft deployment checklist and Laura to share compliance questionnaire.
[00:03:24] Laura Chen: We'll put Solstice's technical contact on that list.
[00:03:30] Jenna Morales: Last one, RetailQ — Tom?
[00:03:33] Tom Alvarez: RetailQ is e-commerce chain, looking at embeddings + reranking for search relevancy. Low latency for recommendations is important, but less sensitive data. They're open to hosted or dedicated.
[00:03:46] Ravi Kapoor: For embeddings, we recommend using Redwood's embedding endpoint with caching; we can show cost estimates — batch offline compute then incremental updates.
[00:03:56] Jenna Morales: Competition: AWS Bedrock was mentioned.
[00:03:59] Laura Chen: Right.
[00:04:01] Marcus Reed: Any blockers on the co-sell ops side? Referral margin and lead routing?
[00:04:06] Jenna Morales: We have a standard co-sell commission and referral program; I'll send the partner playbook PDF. Also need to confirm lead assignment process in CRM.
[00:04:15] Tom Alvarez: CRM question — will Solstice be primary owner or will deals be split? We should clarify for commission.
[00:04:22] Marcus Reed: We prefer Solstice to own initial touch then Redwood to take technical ownership post-fill.
[00:04:28] Jenna Morales: Works. We'll document that in the mutual action plan.
[00:04:33] Laura Chen: A couple of technical Qs from my engineers: can we do a canary rollout for HealthStream and a canary fallback to hosted if private hits perf issues?
[00:04:42] Ravi Kapoor: Yes — Redwood supports smart routing and fallback to compatible model variants/hosted. The routing policy config is straightforward but we'll need to test the KV cache behavior when switching variants.
[00:04:55] Tom Alvarez: Any objections or known risks we should call out?
[00:04:59] Jenna Morales: Pricing pressure from Anthropic/ModelServeX on HealthStream, and timeline risk if compliance answers take too long.
[00:05:09] Marcus Reed: Also network egress approvals can delay HealthStream.
[00:05:13] Jenna Morales: Ok, let's recap and owners.
[00:05:17] Jenna Morales: Jenna — share pricing bands and partner playbook by Friday.
[00:05:21] Ravi Kapoor: Ravi — run FinReg latency benchmark and draft deployment checklist for HealthStream by 2027-01-03.
[00:05:29] Laura Chen: Laura/Solstice — introduce HealthStream tech contact and complete compliance questionnaire by 2026-12-15.
[00:05:37] Tom Alvarez: Tom — confirm CRM ownership model and share updated mutual action plan draft by 2026-12-10.
[00:05:44] Jenna Morales: Great. Any final questions?
[00:05:47] Marcus Reed: None from me.
[00:05:49] Laura Chen: All good.
[00:05:51] Jenna Morales: Thanks everyone, we'll send notes and next steps after the call.
[00:06:00] [call ends]
